title: Rldcoin: Interstellar Peer-to-Peer Payments
authorization_scope: Owner requests resolving issuance-permission invalidation, per-payment preparation and component/history scale; revising the paper/PDF and synchronizing the official website. Research mechanisms only, without protocol runtime or launch.

native_currency.name: runlai
native_currency.currency_identity: C_RLD binds one common authenticated genesis and monetary policy.

issuance.placement: Public proportional-work ClaimRange detaches any 1..256 still-unconsumed slots within a stable allocation generation, under a generic single-source receiving capability. Mint advances a separate cursor/anchor; source splits atomically into exact detached range and disjoint residuals. Final range exports are immutable under subsequent Mint.
issuance.bootstrap: D_0 is an explicitly accepted initial quorum and availability dependency; no claim of Sybil-free equal distribution or trust-free consensus.

work_profile.purpose: Public issuance/distribution only; not validator votes or global monetary history selection. Claim work earns no RLD and does not replace Mint.

mechanisms: Stable placement generation/anchor distinct from mutable Mint cursor/anchor; selected-slot local conflicts still refuse.

Advance finite ReceiveCapability families bind exactly one source, recipient/use policy, fees, object/amount limits and funded proof/current-data/decision capacity; actual inputs and source head are unspecified.
Per-source S[p] exclusive export/authorized closure and destination R[p]/J[x] exclusive import/rejection/source-certified closure; no timeout refund.
Exact normalized exposure-set classes coalesce amounts from different Mint origins; unequal risks remain separate. Issuance identities still checked uniquely in execution.
Candidate execution receipt binds a header; its current PBFT QC is separate. The next recursive step verifies the predecessor receipt and QC. Full current material is retained before onward credit.
Proof-ready export before final debit; local head changes retry with the same unused capability, without payment-specific stellar permission.

proof_reference.required_monetary_binding: Exact trusted verifier/control root, hash/parameters, guest image IDs, successful unconditional claim, full journal codec and resource limits must be authenticated by the monetary descriptor.

equations: U + F + B + Q + Z = C
conservation.conditions: Correct monetary execution/guest, sound unconditional recursive receipts, accepted exclusive PBFT histories, authentic finite keys, current-data availability and durable permanent decisions. Validity does not establish absence of unseen individually valid quorum forks.

mechanism_review.scope: Completed author source/counterexample review, not an independent security audit or executed monetary proof.

claims: Mechanism-level correction and conditional composition/conservation analysis. No completed RLD proof program, achieved latency/volume, qualified cryptographic custody, physical service or guaranteed impact.
limitations: Unknown source/destination or exhausted coupon inventory still requires setup; coupons are never wildcard multi-source capacity.
Local selected-slot consumption or generation splits can invalidate uncommitted work; no extra stellar approval is required for a replacement within unchanged coupon terms.
Proving, including Argon2 work checks, may be expensive; backend facilities alone establish no RLD program correctness or practical performance.
Complete current class/tag/state data is required. Different exposures, permanent decisions and contracted historical archives retain storage costs.
Proof validity cannot exclude an unseen valid quorum fork; arbitrary authorities are not automatically accepted.
Destroyed authorities, unavailable state or lost use keys may strand value/capacity. Finite reserves and crypto do not guarantee perpetual service.
Public work remains hardware-weighted and can concentrate or intentionally strand issuance. No CPU-profitability, equal-human-allocation or calendar guarantee.
implementation_boundary: No protocol/node source, live network, monetary genesis, keys, asset balances, test-value migration or adoption policy is changed. Prior receipts and implementation obligations retain their original scope.
